Nina (Partnerships): quick sync we're aligning marketplace listing + joint announcement. target go-live Mon 2026-05-04 09:00 PST (embargo). main deliverables: partner hero, 2-line partner quote, PR microcopy, SI quickstart link. who picks up what?

deploy-bot: staging build scheduled 2026-04-30T03:00Z - preview: https://staging.redwood.example/marketplace/preview-20260430

Nina (Partnerships): fallback plan if partner art late: use Redwood generic hero + partner badge overlay. Omar add fallback copy to PR.
Omar (Marketing): added fallback text and two CTA variants: "Get started" / "Try now" for A/B. putting PR draft in docs now.
Ken (HW Partner): confirmed quotes + headshot will be sent by Thu EOD. contact: design-team@partner.example for swaps.
Rhea (Product): noted ENG ticket for mobile hero cropping if issues. will QA once staging up.
Ivy (Legal): also require footer logo links point to partner legal pages. Omar pls add link targets.
Nina (Partnerships): timeline recap: Fri 18:15 Omar flags PR ready -> Ivy legal signoff by 19:00 PT -> Sun dry-run -> Mon prod push (embargo lift 09:00 PST). keep this thread for day-of coordination.
Omar (Marketing): will flag here when done. thanks team. :rocket:
